dogecoin.text:
Flare’s State Connector offers a higher level of security by ensuring accurate and verifiable cross-chain information. 

In March 2025, the FDC (Flare Data Connector) goes live, allowing Flare to track events on Dogecoin, Bitcoin, and XRP Ledger in real time.

WHY FLARE NETWORK MATTERS 

Flare’s core vision is to bring smart contract capabilities and the ecosystem of dApps that come with them to blockchains that currently lack them, including:

➥ Bitcoin

➥ XRP Ledger

➥ Dogecoin

➥ Litecoin https://t.co/aZVVWJK0n2

Now that we understand what dApps are, let's think of blockchains as different phone brands. 

Some phones can run certain apps, while others can’t. 

Similarly, some blockchains like Ethereum can run dApps, while others like Bitcoin, XRP, and Dogecoin can’t. https://t.co/TJuJGJaQFR
